notes: Publisher workbook includes employer results, corporate group results and group membership. The reporting unit and years must be preserved; corporate group results are not individual subsidiary measures. Use employer results for this onboarding. A size band is not an exact headcount; remuneration is not revenue. This workbook does not contain all of the dashboard policy/board indicators.
selection_rationale: Test previously unseen structured company intelligence without supplied mappings or ontology additions.
